headline: The parabolic slice x4=0 was computed over the good prime 43. Exact Reynolds-orbit invariants for G32 restrict into the G25 invariant ring, but only through the subring even in the degree-9 generator. The restriction therefore cannot generate the full G25 ring: the degree-6 and sign-sensitive degree-9 invariants are genuinely new parabolic data.

structural_decision.reason: All G32 basic degrees are divisible by 6. On the slice, the degree-9 generator v9 occurs only through v9^2; neither u6 nor v9 can be recovered polynomially from the four restricted basic invariants.

reflection_arrangement_restriction.transverse_discriminant_reading: The full G32 discriminant vanishes on x4=0 because the slice is itself a reflecting hyperplane. After dividing that slice factor, the remaining 39 hyperplanes restrict as the 12 G25 hyperplanes once plus 9 additional hyperplanes with multiplicity three at the hyperplane-product level.

scope: Exact finite-field invariant and reflection-arrangement computation at a good prime. It proves the restriction pattern and non-surjectivity; it does not claim a characteristic-zero canonical normalization of the basic invariant polynomials.
